functions.name: computer_control
functions.title: Control a paired computer
functions.description: List your paired devices, queue one bounded desktop or Cloud Browser action, or read a completion receipt. Requires an admin account and a running paired companion. Queued does not mean executed: poll status. Screenshots are available through the companion's local MCP server, not this remote tool. Never repeat an uncertain action without inspecting the computer.

operation.description: devices lists your devices; send requires device_id, action and arguments; status requires command_id.

x.description: Primary-screen x coordinate, 0–20000; must be inside the actual display.

y.description: Primary-screen y coordinate, 0–20000; must be inside the actual display.

keys.description: Up to four PyAutoGUI key names separated by +, e.g. ctrl+l.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL without credentials, up to 2000 characters.

value.description: Action value up to 1000 characters, or 2000 for a goto URL.
